chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): that he was asked about the man who travels in
the month of Ramadan and fast, so he said: 'Fasting during travel is not from piety (al-birr).'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting while traveling in Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that while fasting while traveling is valid, it is not considered 'al-birr' (optimal piety), reflecting the Shia scholarly preference for convenience (rukhas) over hardship in travel. This distinction highlights the principle that true piety involves adhering to the spirit of the law, which often favors easing burdens for the traveler rather than maintaining the fast unnecessarily. The narration underscores the balance between maintaining religious observance and acknowledging the physical reality of travel.
